name: Crawler Crane
description: A crawler crane is a boom-rotating crane that uses crawler tracks for construction of high-rise buildings. It consists of a power unit, a working mechanism, a boom, a turntable, a chassis, etc. It is characterized by flexible maneuverability, the ability to rotate 360 ​​degrees, and the ability to drive with load on flat and solid ground. Due to the function of the crawler tracks, it can work on soft and muddy ground, and can drive on rugged sites. It has a large grounding area and good passability, and can be used for various operations such as excavation, tamping, piling and so on.
